answer: Reaching eligibility takes 50 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. The umber register is checked at draw time, wander lists the eligible set, and ember seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 50 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 108 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
